I enjoy solving complex engineering problems, driving architectural decisions, and building systems that are reliable, scalable, and easy to evolve.I am always interested in connecting with engineers, founders, and teams working on challenging problems in platform engineering, fintech, AI, SaaS, and large-scale distributed systems.📬 Contact📧 asthana.shubham3092@gmail.com🔗 github.com/shubham-asthana🌐 linkedin.com/in/shubham-asthana3092

current.description:
Client: IG Group
Own the architecture of the payments module in IG's agent dashboard: Java/Spring Boot APIs that servicing agents use to move client money across 5 payment rails (card, bank transfer, PayPal, Apple Pay and US rails), each with different authorisation rules, processing 1,000s of withdrawal and deposit requests a day. 
Designed the withdrawal workflow end to end: multi-account fund selection with balance and margin checks, request queues, payment runs and archival. Server-side eligibility rules block ~15% of requests that would previously have reached the payments team as invalid. 
Consolidated client and account data from 6 upstream systems (Salesforce, Genesys, IGIP) into one low-latency API, replacing 6 separate tool logins for hundreds of internal agents and cutting the time to resolve a payment query by roughly a third. 
Built the compliance and privacy layer: card data stays tokenised and never enters the dashboard, verification checks gate every fund movement, and every state change lands in an audit trail — zero compliance findings since launch. 
Senior-most engineer in a squad of 6: review designs, write the decision records, and ship to production every 2 weeks with a 100% on-time release record.

current.title: Senior Backend Engineer
